annotations.text: Tabs by permission: every member sees Info (with Leave Gang). Manage and Invites appear for the leader and any role with Administrator or Invite members. The leader's Leave Gang becomes Disband Gang (or transfer first) - open question.
Level bar fills with the gang's primary colour. What earns gang XP (turf time, members, jobs) is not specced yet - the 100 / 200 is a placeholder.
Opens anchored under the Add Role button, over the roles list. Edit on a role row opens the same popover pre-filled, with a Delete Role link on the left of Cancel.
Names, colours and portraits are sample data. Portraits stand in for the real figure sprites (LayoutAvatarImageView in the corp roster's circular mask).
